tokoh_utama: A 25-year-old Indonesian male motorcycle taxi driver in a green ride-hailing jacket, short black hair, wearing dark trousers and black shoes.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau kamu dapat orderan ini, kamu ambil atau kabur?
part.caption: Jam 1 malam dapat orderan ojol, titik jemputnya rumah sendiri dan nama pemesannya namaku sendiri...

adegan.narasi: Jam satu malam aku dapat orderan ojol dengan titik jemput rumahku sendiri.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a smartphone screen held by a driver showing a ride-hailing app map pinpointing a residential house at 1:00 AM in dark ambient light.

adegan.narasi: Nama pemesannya persis namaku, Budi, tanpa beda satu huruf pun di layar.
adegan.gambar: Close-up shot of the phone screen highlighting the passenger name profile matching the driver's name in glowing digital text.

adegan.narasi: Seharian ini ban belakang motorku memang terasa aneh saat melewati tikungan sepi.
adegan.gambar: Medium shot of the rear motorcycle wheel parked on a dark asphalt road, dimly illuminated by a streetlamp.

adegan.narasi: Aku menekan tombol batalkan orderan, tapi aplikasi HP-ku mendadak membeku total.
adegan.gambar: A thumb pressing hard on a smartphone screen, the ride-hailing application frozen with red error indicators.

adegan.narasi: Karena penasaran dan agak curiga, aku memutuskan langsung pulang ke rumah.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of a green jacket motorcycle driver riding fast along a empty suburban street under dim streetlights.

adegan.narasi: Jalanan kompleks sangat gelap dan sepi, tidak ada kendaraan lain sama sekali.
adegan.gambar: Point of view shot looking down a quiet dark neighborhood alleyway, eerie fog hanging low on the ground.

adegan.narasi: Begitu sampai di depan pagar, aku kaget melihat lampu kamarku menyala.
adegan.gambar: Eye-level view of a small two-story house with a bright yellow light glowing brightly from a second-floor window.

adegan.narasi: Padahal aku tinggal sendirian dan ingat betul sudah mematikan seluruh lampu teras.
adegan.gambar: Medium shot of the driver standing at the iron gate staring up at the lighted window with a shocked expression.

adegan.narasi: Aku menuntun motorku masuk ke halaman rumah tanpa berani membunyikan mesin.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of the driver pushing his motorcycle quietly into the dark yard. In the dark background behind the fence, a shadowy pale human shape stands silently watching him.

adegan.narasi: Hawa dingin tiba-tiba berembus kencang membuat bulu kudukku berdiri seketika.
adegan.gambar: Close-up on the driver's neck as goosebumps form on his skin under the green jacket collar.

adegan.narasi: Aku perlahan mendongak menatap kaca jendela lantai atas yang terbuka sedikit.
adegan.gambar: Low angle shot looking up at the illuminated second floor window framed by dark roof shadows.

adegan.narasi: Di dalam berdiri seseorang memakai jaket ojol persis denganku, sambil melambaikan tangan.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of the upper window showing a terrifying human figure wearing an identical green motorcycle jacket, smiling unnaturally and waving a slow hand.

part.pertanyaan: Menurut kalian, siapa sebenarnya yang ada di dalam rumah?
part.caption: Lanjutan orderan misterius... Suara di telepon persis suaraku sendiri!

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan orderan misterius, aku nekat menelpon nomor pemesan di aplikasi ojol.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the driver holding the phone to his ear in the dark yard, expression tense and terrified.

adegan.narasi: Sambungan terhubung, suara dari telepon berbisik, "Udah sampai? Aku tunggu di dalam."
adegan.gambar: Dark atmospheric shot of the phone screen showing an ongoing active call timer glowing in the pitch dark.

adegan.narasi: Aku membeku di tempat karena suara itu persis sekali dengan suaraku sendiri.
adegan.gambar: Close-up on the driver's wide eyes and pale face frozen in absolute disbelief and horror.

adegan.narasi: Tangan gemetarku mendorong pintu depan rumah yang ternyata tidak terkunci sama sekali.
adegan.gambar: Medium shot of a hand pushing open a wooden front door, revealing a pitch-black interior hallway.

adegan.narasi: Aku melangkah pelan menaiki tangga kayu yang berdecit di kegelapan malam.
adegan.gambar: Low angle view of feet in boots slowly stepping up dark wooden stairs toward a dimly lit upper doorway.

adegan.narasi: Pintu kamar kubuka perlahan, tapi ruangan itu ternyata kosong tidak ada siapapun.
adegan.gambar: Wide interior shot of a small tidy bedroom illuminated by a desk lamp, completely empty of people.

adegan.narasi: Kipas angin gantung berputar pelan memecah kesunyian kamar yang terasa sangat mencekam.
adegan.gambar: Medium shot of the bedroom interior showing a desk. In the large standing wardrobe mirror on the right side, a tall dark figure's shadow is clearly reflected even though the room is empty.

adegan.narasi: Namun di atas meja, helm cadanganku tampak sangat basah dan terasa masih hangat.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a dark motorcycle helmet sitting on a wooden desk, dripping wet with moisture beads glistening under lamp light.

adegan.narasi: Padahal malam ini tidak ada hujan dan helm itu disimpan di lemari.
adegan.gambar: Medium shot of driver touching the wet helmet surface with trembling fingers, face filled with confusion.

adegan.narasi: Bau tanah basah yang menyengat mendadak memenuhi seluruh ruangan kamar tidurku.
adegan.gambar: Driver sniffing the air nervously, looking around the room as thick spectral mist begins to curl near the floor.

adegan.narasi: Jantungku berdebar kencang saat menyadari keanehan yang baru saja terjadi ini.
adegan.gambar: Close-up shot of driver clutching his chest in fear, breathing heavily while looking towards the open doorway.

adegan.narasi: HP-ku bergetar keras dan status aplikasi mendadak berubah menjadi "Penumpang sudah naik."
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of phone screen glowing red with app notification text reading passenger onboard status.

part.pertanyaan: Menurut kalian, apakah dia menyadari dirinya sudah menjadi hantu?
part.caption: Part Akhir: Rute lokasi tujuan membawa ke bekas lokasi kecelakaan...

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan malam mencekam, aku nekat mengendarai motor mengikuti rute lokasi tujuan.
adegan.gambar: Point of view shot riding a motorcycle on a dark deserted rural road illuminated only by headlight beam.

adegan.narasi: Sepanjang perjalanan, jok belakang motorku terasa sangat berat seolah membonceng seseorang.
adegan.gambar: Medium shot of the rear motorcycle seat pressing down low under invisible heavy weight while riding.

adegan.narasi: Kaca spion tidak memperlihatkan bayangan apapun, tapi napas dingin menembus jaket leherku.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of side rearview mirror showing empty pitch dark road behind, contrasting with cold fog around driver's neck.

adegan.narasi: Aplikasi menuntun jalanku menuju sebuah tikungan sepi yang sangat gelap di desa.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of a sharp dangerous road curve bounded by dense trees and a concrete utility pole at night.

adegan.narasi: Di lokasi itu, terlihat bekas gesekan ban motor yang masih baru di jalan.
adegan.gambar: Close-up on black skid marks baked onto asphalt leading directly into a damaged concrete pole.

adegan.narasi: Sebuah karangan bunga duka cita tergeletak tepat di samping tiang listrik jalan.
adegan.gambar: Medium shot of fresh funeral flowers lying at the foot of the electricity pole in dim moonlight.

adegan.narasi: Aku melangkah mendekat dan membaca pita duka bertuliskan namaku serta tanggal hari ini.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the ribbon on the funeral wreath showing driver's full name and today's date written clearly.

adegan.narasi: Aku mendadak teringat kecelakaan hebat yang menimpaku di tikungan ini sore tadi.
adegan.gambar: Cinematic visual flash of a green motorcycle crashing hard into the pole under dark overcast sky.

adegan.narasi: Jam di layarku menunjukkan tepat angka satu malam tanpa ada detik bergeser.
adegan.gambar: Driver holding phone showing 01:00 AM. In the cracked motorcycle mirror behind his shoulder, a pale ghost figure wearing a matching jacket looks directly forward.

adegan.narasi: Ternyata orderan misterius ini adalah jemputan ajalku yang tidak mau pergi sendirian.
adegan.gambar: Wide eerie shot of the driver standing near the funeral flowers as shadowy specters surround the quiet road curve.

adegan.narasi: Aku berteriak hysteris saat menyadari kalau aku sudah tidak bernyawa lagi.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of driver screaming in terror with mouth wide open, figure fading semi-transparent in moonlight.

adegan.narasi: Sejak malam itu, setiap kali motorku berjalan, kursi belakang selalu terasa sangat berat.
adegan.gambar: Dark silhouette of an empty motorcycle driving alone into an infinite foggy road, back seat sunk low.
